c10FailureExplanation: C10 IS parseable. The parser extracted 11 faces successfully. The EXP-033 script filtered on faceType === 'planar_cube' and secCount being defined, but C10's Face 0 has secCount=1 and faceType=planar_other (ec=10, vc=10). The remaining 10 faces have faceType=planar_cube. The 'no parseable faces' report was caused by the EXP-033 script's filtering logic, not a structural parsing failure.

c10Structure.description: Shell hollows out the cube, removing the +Z face and creating inner walls. C10 has 11 faces: 5 original outer faces (Faces 1-5), 1 modified top face (Face 0, ec=10, vc=10, multi-loop), and 5 new inner wall faces (Faces 6-10).

originalOuterFaceComparison.description: Comparison of C10's original outer faces (Faces 1-5) against C00's corresponding faces
originalOuterFaceComparison.conclusion: Shell operation does NOT change tokens on existing outer faces

newInnerFaceAnalysis.description: Analysis of C10's new inner wall faces (Faces 6-10)
newInnerFaceAnalysis.pattern: Each inner face has a unique token signature not found in C00

hypothesisExplanations.H1: FALSIFIED because the 5 original outer faces (Faces 1-5) have IDENTICAL tokens to C00. Shell does NOT change tokens on existing faces.
hypothesisExplanations.H2: SUPPORTED because all original outer face tokens are identical to C00.
hypothesisExplanations.H3: NOT_APPLICABLE because H2 is supported (no changes to compare).
hypothesisExplanations.H4: FALSIFIED because C10 IS parseable under the validated extraction model. All 11 faces pass INV-016/017/018.

keyFindings: C10 IS parseable under the validated extraction model (11 faces, all pass INV-016/017/018)
EXP-033's 'no parseable faces' report was a tooling/filtering issue, not a structural parsing failure
C10 has 11 faces: 5 original outer faces (Faces 1-5), 1 modified top face (Face 0, ec=10, vc=10), 5 new inner wall faces (Faces 6-10)
Shell operation does NOT change tokens on existing outer faces (5/5 IDENTICAL to C00)
Shell operation adds 5 new inner wall faces with unique token signatures
Shell operation modifies the +Z face from ec=4/vc=4 to ec=10/vc=10 (multi-loop)
New inner face tokens are NOT found in C00 — they are shell-specific signatures
All C10 faces pass INV-016 (b1Len = 2*(vc-secCount)) and INV-018 (sum(b2Body) = b1Len)

relationshipToEXP033.description: EXP-033 reported C10 as 'no parseable faces'. EXP-035 determines this was a filtering issue in the EXP-033 script, not a structural parsing failure.
relationshipToEXP033.exp033FilterIssue: The EXP-033 script filtered faces by faceType === 'planar_cube'. C10's Face 0 has faceType=planar_other (ec=10, vc=10), but Faces 1-10 have faceType=planar_cube. The script should have found 10 planar_cube faces.
relationshipToEXP033.exp033CorrectedResult: If the filter had worked correctly, EXP-033 would have shown that C10's original outer faces have IDENTICAL tokens to C00, and C10's new inner faces have unique token signatures.

relationshipToEXP034.description: EXP-034 showed that geometric transformations (scale, translation) do NOT change tokens. EXP-035 shows that shell (which modifies external boundary) also does NOT change tokens on existing faces. This further supports the conclusion that Block1 tokens are invariant under geometric operations.
